title: Perps back navigation returns to the screen the user came from
description: Places a Lite BTC order the way a user does and proves the market page's back arrow returns to Perps home instead of the order screen (TAT-3906), then runs the focused unit tests that pin the post-deposit Pro navigation (TAT-3874).

setup-status.intent: Confirm the mobile bridge is reachable before touching the app

setup-unlock.intent: Make the wallet usable so Perps screens can render

setup-open-perps.intent: Start from the Perps home screen the reporter came from in step 1

gate-perps-home.intent: Confirm Perps home is the screen sitting underneath the market page

setup-open-market.intent: Open the BTC market page in Lite mode where the trade is placed

setup-clean-market.intent: Leave BTC with no open position so the market page offers Long rather than Close

gate-market-page.intent: Confirm the BTC Lite market page is offering a new position rather than an existing one

ac1-open-order-form.intent: Open the Lite long order form the way the reporter did

ac1-wait-order-form.intent: Confirm the BTC trade screen is open with its default order ready to submit

ac1-place-order.intent: Submit the order through the visible Place order control

ac1-wait-position-open.intent: Confirm the order was accepted and the app returned to the BTC market page

ac1-press-back.intent: Leave the BTC market page the way a user does after their trade lands

ac1-assert-order-screen-gone.intent: Confirm Back did not land the user back on the BTC trade screen

ac1-assert-back-to-perps-home.intent: Confirm Back returned to Perps home, the screen the user came from

ac1-screenshot-perps-home.label: AC1: Back from the post-order market page shows Perps home
ac1-screenshot-perps-home.intent: Preserve visible proof that Back reaches Perps home, not the trade screen

ac2-run-navigation-unit-tests.intent: Exercise the post-deposit Pro navigation helper that TAT-3874 reported, which needs a funded on-chain deposit to reach on a device

ac2-assert-navigation-unit-tests-pass.intent: Confirm the Pro add-funds and Lite post-order navigation contracts both hold

ac2-index-test-log.intent: Attach the unit-test output as reviewable evidence for the Pro add-funds claim

teardown-clean-market.intent: Return the BTC testnet market to the clean state the run started from
